question: Can fixed prior-month industry members support consecutive monthly disclosed financial TTM change under both proxy clocks, without PE selection?
hypothesis: Newly visible earnings improvement may support sustained fundamentals; first audit breadth/coverage, not forecast efficacy
period: All81 financial month-end dates2020-01..2026-09; first month has unknown prior endpoint, no backfill
stock_rule: Exact prior calendar month by security_id and clock; both financial_snapshot_linked/known_ttm, finite profit, report/component availability<=endpoint date; no price, cap, PE or comparison_eligible filtering
metric: 2*(current-prior)/(abs(current)+abs(prior)); bothzero=0. Negative profits valid, range[-2,2]. This is bounded change, not conventional profit growth.
transition: Known pairs classified same/advanced/regressed report period; unknown latest does not fall back. Unchanged report values legitimately imply0 only when both endpoints known.
membership: R108 prior-month members, unfiltered by cap ranking, price return or leader readiness; exact signal/origin dates; named+unresolved full denominator
aggregation: Each clock independent; >=5 total members and known>=80% full denominator for subset mean/breadth; strict100 separately. No threshold search. Noneligible featuresNaN, coverage retained. Full-population mean onlystrict.
outputs: Stock endpoints/status; full member ledger perclock; full industry grid perclock; coverage byera/level/year/clock, common eligibility, source hashes
limits: No future targets, no models, no clock selection, no PE match filter, no strictPIT or causal/investment claim. If coverage insufficient report it; do not lower threshold.
